_comment: Published posts whose stored title runs two cover rows together, waiting for their stored data to be corrected. Empty since the historical backfill (PR C, scripts/backfill-report-metadata.mjs) corrected the five that did: the titles are fixed in the data, never by the reader. tests/report-metadata-detection.test.mjs and tests/report-title-spacing.test.mjs fail on any title that differs from its cover by spacing alone and is not listed here.
